# 581. 100 min med Bråse och Qvarnström

**Feed**: sparpodden  
**Published**: 2026-08-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Sparpodden hosts Rickard Bråse, who has run a fund at Protean for about 1.5 years, and Olle Qvarnström, who launches a global fund on 15 September. They describe a split Nordic market: large caps in banking, mining, defence and AI data-centre themes are expensive, while many companies under 100 billion SEK in market value trade near five-year lows on attractive free-cash-flow yields. They favour contrarian, cash-flow-based investing and criticise the 2021 excesses, US valuations and adjusted earnings that exclude stock-based compensation.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SECU-B — Securitas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

About 7.5% rolling free-cash-flow yield plus a CMD target of 10% EPS growth. Gets paid while waiting, and would be fine to own even unlisted.

#### Reasoning

Guest Rickard Bråse (fund manager at Protean) gives Securitas as his example of positive carry below 100 billion SEK in market value. A free-cash-flow yield of about 7.5% plus about 10% EPS growth gives a high implied return floor, so things must go badly for the outcome not to be OK. He frames it as a long-term, cash-flow-based hold he would own for 5-10 years, but does not explicitly confirm he owns it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EPS growth falls well short of the 10% CMD target
- if free-cash-flow yield compresses on a large rerating
- if cash conversion deteriorates

> *"Jag träffade Securitas igår. Då har du free cash field på rullande 12, på 7,5 procent eller någonting."*

---

### 🟠 VIT-B — Vitec Software | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Derated from a premium compounder to low valuation on AI fears. Bråse's 'take the lame Lotta' contrarian framing hints at interest.

#### Reasoning

Bråse notes Vitec went from trading at a premium to Constellation Software, when he was not interested, to a much lower valuation after the AI disruption narrative took hold. His Emil i Lönneberga analogy suggests contrarian interest in unloved assets, but he makes no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI actually erodes the vertical-software customer base
- if organic growth and cash flow stall

> *"Bitech är väl kanske det bästa svenska exemplet egentligen som som gick ifrån att vara typ dyraste compounden"*
